name: Simple Slot Block
summary: Server-side GameGUI script that lets missions open, block or kick player slots using user flags.
description: Server hook (SimpleSlotBlockGameGUI.lua) installed on the server, not in the mission. Missions enable it by setting flag `SSB` to 100 and control each slot through a flag named after the group.

releases.changelog: Version string from ssb.version in the script; date is last commit.
